decisions.reason: As a simple accessory linked to the installed trailer base, it likely meets modest aspiration levels and consumes very little organisational slack, so retention is the behavioral-theory-consistent choice.

The car transporter trailer line remains somewhat niche and therefore faces a higher withdrawal risk, but surviving several years suggests results have been close enough to aspiration to justify continued use of existing production and service capabilities.
The low-bed trailer series fits the firm’s core professional hauling business and, after several years on the market, would normally be kept unless performance clearly fell below aspiration.

The high trailer cover series complements the main trailer range and can be sold and supported through the current network, so an established medium-sized German manufacturer would usually continue it absent clear evidence of shortfall.
